edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the transfer sender in the ERC20 transfer entry point.
msg.sender is used as the spender in transferFrom allowance accounting.
msg.sender is passed as the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the from address.
setBots authorises the caller through the onlyOwner modifier using _msgSender.
renounceOwnership is gated by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender to _owner.
increaseMaxTxPercentage is gated by onlyOwner using _msgSender.
addToSwap is gated by onlyOwner using _msgSender.
addLiquidity is gated by onlyOwner using _msgSender.
enableTrading is gated by onlyOwner using _msgSender.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline, making execution time dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
transfer calls _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
approve delegates to _approve.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth, an external-call-bearing routine, before finishing state settlement.
_transfer forwards contract ETH through sendETHToFee which performs an external ETH transfer.
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer.
_transfer assigns the fee slot _feeAddr1.
_transfer assigns the fee slot _feeAddr2.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount for the buy limit check.
_transfer reads tradingOpen to gate buys.
_transfer reads and swapTokensForEth mutates the inSwap lock flag.
_transfer reads swapEnabled before triggering the swap branch.
_transfer consults the _isExcludedFromFee mapping.
_transfer checks the bots blacklist mapping.
swapTokensForEth makes an external router call that can re-enter via token transfer hooks.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve.
swapTokensForEth is wrapped by lockTheSwap which toggles inSwap.
swapTokensForEth reads the uniswapV2Router state variable.
sendETHToFee performs an unchecked ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
The ETH transfer target is the _feeWallet state variable.
increaseMaxTxPercentage computes the new limit using mul and div.
The computed value is stored into _maxTxAmount.
increaseMaxTxPercentage scales _tTotal by the supplied percentage.
addToSwap calls the factory createPair through the router.
addToSwap assigns the uniswapV2Router state variable.
addToSwap assigns the uniswapV2Pair state variable.
addToSwap approves the router via _approve.
addLiquidity performs an external payable router call forwarding contract ETH.
addLiquidity sets swapEnabled to true.
addLiquidity reads the uniswapV2Router state variable.
enableTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
setBots performs the looped blacklist state mutation, protected only by onlyOwner.
The bot flag is written into the bots mapping.
setBots compares loop entries against uniswapV2Router.
setBots compares loop entries against uniswapV2Pair.
renounceOwnership permanently clears ownership.
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into _owner.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard debits and credits the _rOwned mapping.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee.
_takeTeam adds team reflections to _rOwned of the contract.
_takeTeam reads the current rate from _getRate.
_reflectFee subtracts the fee from _rTotal using SafeMath.
_getValues reads the current rate from _getRate.
tokenFromReflection divides by the current rate from _getRate.
tokenFromReflection bounds the reflection amount by _rTotal.
manualswap is publicly callable with no access control and invokes the swap routine.
manualsend is publicly callable with no access control and drains contract ETH.
from parameter feeds the zero-address and bot checks in _transfer.
to parameter feeds the pair/exclusion branch in _transfer.
amount parameter feeds the _maxTxAmount comparison and token transfer.
contractTokenBalance local is consumed by the swap call inside _transfer.
tokenAmount is approved and swapped by swapTokensForEth.
path local array is passed to the router swap.
amount is forwarded as the ETH value to the fee wallet.
percentage drives the new max tx computation.
bots_ array is iterated to write the blacklist.
isBot flag is written into the blacklist mapping.
recipient parameter is the transfer target.
amount parameter is the transfer quantity.
sender parameter is the debited address in transferFrom.
recipient parameter is the credited address in transferFrom.
tAmount is decomposed into reflection amounts.
_uniswapV2Router local is assigned to the uniswapV2Router state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to parameterise the caller's address inside _transfer.
The to parameter only exists to parameterise the recipient inside _transfer.
The amount parameter only exists to parameterise the limit check and transfer inside _transfer.
tokenAmount is only meaningful as the swap input of swapTokensForEth.
amount is only meaningful as the ETH value forwarded by sendETHToFee.
percentage is exclusively consumed by the max tx limit update computation.
bots_ is only iterated inside the owner-only setBots loop.
isBot is only used to write the blacklist flag inside setBots.
recipient is only forwarded to _transfer by the ERC20 transfer entry point.
amount is only forwarded to _transfer by the ERC20 transfer entry point.
sender is only forwarded to _transfer and allowance math by transferFrom.
recipient is only forwarded to _transfer by transferFrom.
The cached contract balance is a transient value used solely in _transfer's swap branch.
tAmount is the transient input decomposed by _transferStandard.
The hardcoded router local is immediately stored into state by addToSwap.
The path array is a transient argument constructed for the router swap call.
